$comment: Wave V5 of docs/COMPONENT-VARIANTS-PLAN.md: the effect kinds (text and number effects, wrapper, backdrop, marquee, slides, row). Their variants are named parameter presets rather than visual styles. params use the vocabulary in parameters (absent means the default); motion names a preset from motion.json presets per phase, "effect" for the component's own movement, or null. css is the root selector the generated variant rules use. tools/gen-motion.mjs turns this file and motion.json into each pack's tables and the shared CSS.

speed.doc: Pace: durations are divided by it and timers run that much faster

intensity.doc: How strong the effect is: blur, distance, glare, frosting, edge size

density.doc: How many: particles, dots, lines, burst dots

direction.doc: Which way it moves; the default is the component's own

effect.doc: Which movement, for components that offer several

easing.doc: The curve; the default is the component's own

palettes.$comment: Token roles, darkest-safe ones so text effects keep their contrast. Web: --bx-<role>; React Native maps them to its theme colours.
